Remark
[Variation of a covariant derivative of a vector field] 1. ch2:3.2 Source: topping:page-0030 \group topping-background

For a time-dependent vector field $V=V(t)$, \[ rac{\partial }{\partial t} abla _XV =\Pi (X,V)+ abla _X rac{\partial V}{\partial t}. \]
